policy: No separate exploratory screen: the certified run is the only search.
At most one attempt per route under this delta (creation-only route directory); a further attempt or limit change needs a new parent decision.
At most one C311+cuts pipeline at a time (advisory lock on the driver file).

supervision: Production domain, stated exactly: the pinned lane Python worker (driver, generator or controls), the pinned encoder-B Python child, and cadical/kissat/drat-trim. The supervisor's scope is the command's process group only; members keep it across re-parenting; a process leaving the group is detected while still a child of a live member, is never signalled, and quarantines capacity.

Strict probes every 0.25 s against a fresh group listing from the same sample: alive needs full BSD and task reads with RSS > 0; zombie needs BSD status SZOMB or (Darwin) ESRCH while the pid is still listed in our process group; gone is ESRCH while not listed; anything else is unknown and trips as uncertain. A failed RSS read is never evidence of death; a listing failure is uncertain.
Trips: RSS > cap, free < floor, elapsed > wall, external SIGTERM/SIGINT, member alive after leader exit, and uncertainty (unknown probe, failed listing, leader gone while unreaped, escape).

Stop: killpg(group, SIGTERM) only while live or unknown members exist and only while the leader is unreaped (its zombie reserves the group ID); a zombie-only group is not signalled; a killpg failure while live members exist leaves them as quarantined survivors; bounded 30 s wait; no SIGKILL; no subprocess timeout.

Fail-closed exception path (from r2): any exception after the command starts records an uncertain UNKNOWN, stops the reserved group with a bounded wait and quarantines; if measurement fails during the stop, one killpg, a bounded unmeasured wait, survivors unknown; the record is always attempted (fallback RECORD.failure.json) and signal handlers are restored in finally.
Completion: a final synchronous check of members, RSS, floor and wall before reaping the leader.
Workers refuse to run unless they are the session/group leader under the supervisor file and SHA pinned in this frozen delta (K3_SUPERVISOR_PID, K3_SUPERVISOR_SCRIPT, getsid/getpgrp).
